the-shipment.where: Before dawn, a riverboat lies moored beside a rickety pier on a quiet, misty fork of the Mordava. Lyra stands in its lamplit cabin before the crate, Reinhard beside her and Silas by the only door. Elves guard the deck. Poppen hides in the bushes at the treeline above the gangway, and Thalbern in a thicket on the bank below the stern. Neither hide can be seen from the other.

the-transaction.where: The riverboat's lamplit cabin at the rickety pier, the crate in the middle and the only door opening forward onto the deck. Outside, Poppen hides in the bushes at the treeline above the gangway, and Thalbern in a thicket on the bank below the stern.

the-disturbance.where: Before dawn at the riverboat's pier. Something stirred on the bank. Poppen hides in the bushes at the treeline above the gangway, and Thalbern in a thicket on the bank below the stern.

the-escape.where: A trail runs from the pier along the misty riverbank and into the woods toward Kordavos.

the-fake.where: The riverboat's lamplit cabin. The crate sits in the middle, and the only door opens forward onto the deck. Outside, Poppen hides in the bushes at the treeline above the gangway, and Thalbern in a thicket on the bank below the stern.

battle-on-the-boat.where: The riverboat's lamplit cabin. The crate sits in the middle, and the only door opens forward onto the deck. Outside, Poppen hides in the bushes at the treeline above the gangway, and Thalbern in a thicket on the bank below the stern.

overboard.where: The pier just before dawn, after the riverboat has cast off and gone downstream into the mist. The gangway ends over open water. Lyra stands soaked in the reeds beside it. Poppen is in the bushes at the treeline above the gangway, and Thalbern in a thicket on the bank downstream. Neither hide can be seen from the other.

the-crate.where: The riverboat's cabin, quiet now. The heavy iron-banded crate sits in the middle under hanging rope.

return-to-the-city.where: The quay along the river in Kordavos, ships at their moorings and the castle on its hill above the city.

the-end.where: A mossy path winds between huge old trees in green-gold light.
